One angle formed by the left vertical line and the slanted line is labeled (3y - 11)°, and the corresponding angle formed by the right vertical line and the same slanted line is labeled (y + 19)°. Reasoning: Because the two vertical lines are parallel and are cut by the same slanted line, these two corresponding acute angles are equal. Therefore 3y - 11 = y + 19.
